viewer: query { viewer { login name avatarUrl contributionsCollection { contributionYears restrictedContributionsCount contributionCalendar { totalContributions weeks { contributionDays { date contributionCount color } } } } } }
profile: query($login:String!) { user(login:$login) { login name avatarUrl contributionsCollection { contributionYears restrictedContributionsCount contributionCalendar { totalContributions weeks { contributionDays { date contributionCount color } } } } } }
history: query($login:String!, $from:DateTime!, $to:DateTime!) { user(login:$login) { login name avatarUrl contributionsCollection(from:$from,to:$to) { contributionYears restrictedContributionsCount contributionCalendar { totalContributions weeks { contributionDays { date contributionCount color } } } } } }
following: query($after:String) { viewer { following(first:100, after:$after) { nodes { login name avatarUrl } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
